list.title: Bills
list.description: Vendor bills and credit memos — your accounts payable: draft → approval → posted through the kernel.

capture.title: Bill capture
capture.description: Upload invoices in batches, review extracted evidence beside the source, and create controlled AP drafts.

capture.uploadFailed: The documents could not be uploaded.
capture.notConfigured: Document capture is not operational because it is disabled or missing its organization provider configuration.
capture.configure: Configure it under Admin Center → AI.
capture.emptyDescription: Upload PDF, JPEG, PNG, or TIFF vendor documents to begin.

issues.invalid_currency: Enter a valid three-letter currency code.
issues.amount_out_of_range: The amount is outside the supported accounting range.
issues.missing_lines: Add at least one invoice line.
issues.missing_line_description: Line {line} has no description or product code.
issues.line_math_mismatch: Line {line} does not equal quantity × unit price (expected {expected}, found {actual}).
issues.low_confidence: Line {line} is below the confidence threshold.
issues.document_low_confidence: The document is below the review confidence threshold.
issues.subtotal_mismatch: The line subtotal is {expected}, but the document says {actual}.
issues.line_tax_mismatch: Line tax totals {expected}, but the document says {actual}.
issues.total_mismatch: Subtotal plus tax is {expected}, but the document says {actual}.
issues.purchase_order_unresolved: The purchase order could not be resolved uniquely.
issues.po_line_unmatched: Line {line} could not be matched uniquely to the purchase order.
issues.po_quantity_exceeded: Line {line} exceeds the unbilled purchase-order quantity ({expected}).
issues.receipt_quantity_shortfall: Line {line} exceeds received, unbilled quantity ({expected}); receive the goods first.
issues.possible_duplicate: A capture or AP document already has this file or vendor invoice number.

cockpit.title: Accounts Payable
cockpit.description: Your payables control center — what you owe, what's overdue, and what to pay this week.
cockpit.noPayables: No open payables. You're all caught up.

panels.payRunHint: Bills predicted due this week — select and build a payment run
panels.payRunHintScheduled: Recommended under your weekly capacity — oldest due first

payRun.empty: No bills predicted due this week.

settings.title: How AP-to-pay is selected
settings.weeklyCapHelp: Most to pay per week — 0 = unlimited. Bills are chosen oldest-due first up to this cap; the rest defers.
settings.safeHelp: Never recommend paying beyond the cash available that week (projected inflows − outflows). Overflow defers forward.

cockpit.deferralNote: {amount} of payables can't be paid within the horizon under the current AP capacity settings — the backlog spills past the last week. Adjust the cap in the cash-flow forecast configuration.
